RADON.gloss: a radioactive gaseous element formed by the disintegration of radium
RADON.definition: A radioactive gaseous element formed by the disintegration of radium; the heaviest of the inert gasses; occurs naturally (especially in areas over granite) and is considered a hazard to health.

ADORN.gloss: make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
ADORN.definition: Make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
ADORN.example: Decorate the room for the party.

ROAD.gloss: an open way for travel or transportation
ROAD.definition: An open way (generally public) for travel or transportation.

RAND.gloss: the basic unit of money in South Africa
RAND.definition: The basic unit of money in South Africa; equal to 100 cents.

DON.gloss: teacher at a university or college
DON.definition: Teacher at a university or college (especially at Cambridge or Oxford).

ROD.gloss: a long thin implement made of metal or wood
ROD.definition: A long thin implement made of metal or wood.
